spec_match.rationale: Exercises the motivating contract — custom UI painted with background: AccentColor / color: AccentColorText matching native accent-color-tinted controls — plus the css-ui-4 inheritance behaviour via a nested accent-color override affecting both families.

interactive.rationale: Color picker rethemes the card live; pressed chips toggle aria-pressed and label; the range drives the progress element; every state change refreshes a computed-color readout from getComputedStyle().

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises native + custom families from one accent plus the inheritance story; the page has exactly those panels including the nested override box.

edge_cases.rationale: On builds without the keywords the custom family drops to labelled design-system fallbacks while native controls still follow accent-color — the page names that visible drift as the pre-157 state rather than hiding it; Forced Colors Mode is called out in the mismatch branch.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6207138742534144 and the css-ui-4 widget-accent section; crumbs link the feature index which carries the full reference list.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite asserts the follows-value equality, per-element resolution and inheritance that this page demonstrates; the shared panel runs it on-page.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): picker driven to #1a2aa0 (card accent-color computed rgb(26,42,160)), chip toggled twice (aria-pressed false→true round trip with label change), range 90 drove progress to 90, nested box computed accent rgb(139,0,0), zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow, desktop screenshot read. Partial: the keywords do not parse on this build, so the matched-family branch has no browser evidence here — the honest-drift branch ran instead.

telemetry_health.rationale: accentcolor-widgets-readout assertion fires on load; event handlers re-run report() without console noise.

design_system.rationale: Fallback inks for the custom family are var(--text-black)/var(--bg-ivory) and var(--bg-stone)/var(--text-charcoal) pairs (AA); the keyword declarations layer on top only where they parse.

accessibility.rationale: Chips are native buttons with aria-pressed; native checkbox/radio/range/progress have visible labels; the custom meter exposes role=img with aria-labelledby and aria-description; the computed readout is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; control grid collapses via auto-fit minmax.

openQuestions.title: Capture the matched-family screenshot on a Chrome 157+ build
openQuestions.detail: On this pre-157 build the custom family shows its labelled fallback inks. On Chrome 157+, verify the pressed chip background equals the card accent computed color, the nested chip follows the override, and the readout reports 'Matched'.

guidanceConsulted.query: theming custom controls to match native form controls accent color
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Maintain AA for text and 3:1 non-text contrast for control boundaries/states; don't rely on color alone for state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Chip pressed state is conveyed by aria-pressed and a label change, not color alone; all fallback pairs are AA; control borders are 1-2px border-black on light surfaces (>3:1).

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button pressed state accessible form control labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with aria-pressed for toggles; label every input; 44px minimum targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Chips are <button aria-pressed> with min-height 44px; checkbox/radio/range/progress all have visible <label>s; family labels are 44px-tall flex rows.

summary: Product-angle demo: one accent-color drives native controls while AccentColor/AccentColorText paint custom chips, badges and a meter, with a nested inheritance override. Driven in headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): all controls exercised, honest-drift fallback branch verified, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
